scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('package-lock.json', { force: true }); fs.rmSync('yarn.lock', { force: true });"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.vercel-build: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/antyakshari run build && rm -rf ./dist && cp -r artifacts/antyakshari/dist ./dist && cp ./dist/index.html ./dist/404.html && node scripts/bundle-api.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
